title: Agree Or Disagree Essays
content: In agree/disagree essays, state your position clearly and keep it consistent. A safe structure is introduction, reason 1, reason 2, and conclusion. A common mistake is discussing both sides equally without making your own opinion clear.

title: Discuss Both Views Essays
content: Discuss both views essays require a fair explanation of two opinions. Usually body 1 explains the view you support less, and body 2 explains the view you support more. Add your own opinion if the question asks for it.

title: Task 2 Essay Type Difference
content: The key difference is the task demand. Agree/disagree asks for your position on one statement. Discuss both views asks you to explain two views. Problem/solution asks for causes or problems and practical solutions. Match your paragraph plan to the exact instruction.
